hero.eyebrow: Powered by Sarvagya · agentic RAG over NCERT
hero.h1: The AI tutor that shows its sources.
hero.lede: NCERT-grounded answers, Bloom-tagged and citation-backed. An adaptive Practest engine and offline-ready study tools — built for CBSE & ICSE learners, Classes 6–12.

sections.h2: Everything a serious learner needs, in one place.
intro: Cutting-edge retrieval and assessment powering a personalised, trustworthy learning experience.

p: Conversational AI with role-based answers, CBSE/ICSE alignment and citation-backed retrieval over the NCERT books themselves — not a scraped approximation of them.
Adaptive assessment with intelligent question generation and real-time, chapter-level performance analytics that point at the specific gap.
A clean Board → Class → Subject → Chapter hierarchy with metadata tagging, so a question is always findable and always in the right context.
CAT algorithms move difficulty up and down with performance, so a learner spends their time at the edge of what they know rather than repeating what they've mastered.
Mastery tracked by cognitive level, with honest strength and gap reporting — remembering a definition and applying it are scored as the different skills they are.
Visual, reading and practice modes so every learner meets the material in the way they actually think best.

sections.h2: From doubt to mastery in three steps.

p: Type a doubt in Hindi or English from any NCERT chapter, Classes 6–12.
Every answer cites the exact textbook page and tags its Bloom's level, so the learner can check it and the teacher can trust it.
Practest tunes difficulty to the learner and tracks mastery until it sticks.

sections.h2: The productivity suite.
intro: A learning app should protect focus and motivation, not just serve content. These tools — built for Indian students — do exactly that.

p: Indian-context flashcards, live quiz battles and cultural badges that make revision something a student actually returns to.
Download lessons, tests and notes, study with zero internet, and sync smartly on reconnect — because connectivity is not a given.
Blocks distracting apps during study, with a whitelist the student controls and an emergency escape so it never becomes a trap.
Tracks how a learner is feeling and adapts the schedule — coaching that protects motivation, not just marks.
Progress insight and direct messaging so families stay in the loop without the nagging.
Adaptive study timers tuned to the grade and the CBSE/ICSE syllabus, with engagement tracked over the term. Plus Mitram, a focus companion that runs quick attention checks.

hero.h1: AI-powered digital library for Indian institutions.
hero.lede: Read, listen, and chat with your books. Equip students with responsive EPUBs, page-accurate PDFs, natural text-to-speech — and Varta, the study assistant that answers doubts with strict textbook citations.

sections.h2: Four ways to read one book.
intro: Upload once. Every title instantly becomes a reflowable EPUB, a page-accurate PDF, a natural-voice audiobook, and an AI you can talk to. Switch modes anytime — highlights, bookmarks and progress sync across all four.

p: Font size, sepia mode and a clean reading column that respects the publisher's layout. Distraction-free by design, on a laptop or a ₹8,000 phone.
The exact page a lecturer refers to, with the exact numbering. Every Varta citation links back to a page and paragraph a student can verify by eye.
Every book becomes listenable. Study at the desk, revise on the bus — progress carries back to the text when they open it again.

sections.h2: The book that answers back.
intro: Most AI guesses. Varta reads your textbook and answers only from it — with a citation you can verify on the page. If it isn't in the book, Varta says so.

p: Every claim links back to the exact page and paragraph in the source book, so a student — or an examiner — can check it in seconds.
Turn any explanation into spaced-repetition cards in one tap, without leaving the page they were reading.
Generate questions from the chapter in front of them, pitched at the material actually covered rather than a generic bank.

cards.h3: A study archive that builds itself
p: Highlights, Varta explanations, annotations and flashcards collect automatically across every book — one evolving notebook to revise from.

cards.h3: A full annotation studio in the browser
p: Freehand ink, smart shapes, highlights, redaction, OCR search and audio notes — Drawboard-grade tools with no download, syncing to Sanchika across devices.

cards.h3: See what they read. Know what they skip.
p: Assign books to batches, then read the struggling-chapter heatmap: which pages take longest, which chapters trigger the most Varta questions, who is falling behind.

sections.h2: Enterprise-grade. Built for institutions.
intro: From a single coaching centre to a multi-campus university, the same architecture scales without ever mixing one institution's data with another's.

p: Every institution's data lives in its own logical boundary. One breach can never cross tenants — the separation is structural, not a query filter.
Model campuses, branches and departments, and assign books and seats per branch rather than flattening a university into one list.
Super Admin, Admin, Librarian, Teacher and Student — across both institutional (B2B) and independent (B2C) accounts, with SSO from Vidyaverse.

p: The campus OS that issues the login and the roles the library trusts.

hero.h1: Practise like it's the real exam hall.
hero.lede: Server-timed CBT mocks with the exact palette, section locks and negative marking of SSC, Banking, Railways, UPSC and State PCS papers — plus video courses and analytics that tell you precisely where marks are leaking.

sections.h2: Every detail of the exam hall, replicated.
intro: Engineered for SSC CGL, SBI PO, SBI Clerk, IBPS, Railways RRB, UPSC and State PCS aspirants across India.

cards.h3: Five states, exactly as SSC & IBPS render them
p: Answered, not answered, marked for review, answered & marked, not visited — the same colours, the same teardrop shape, the same section locks. When you sit the real CBT, nothing surprises you.

cards.h3: A timer the browser cannot cheat
p: Timing is server-authoritative to within a second, and auto-submit fires on the server when time expires — even if the tab is closed or the laptop dies.
Every answer autosaves as it is marked. Internet drops mid-section, and the attempt resumes exactly where it stopped — with the clock still honest.
Every submission is re-scored on the server from raw answers: accuracy, time-per-question, subject and topic breakdowns, batch percentile and rank — recomputed, never estimated.
Modules and lessons in exam order with watched-seconds logged automatically. Close the tab mid-lecture and the player reopens within seconds of where you stopped, on any device.
Coaching institutes issue activation codes that unlock a batch instantly, with all-India rank and percentile computed across the cohort.

sections.h2: From sign-up to scorecard in three steps.

p: Create a free account and verify email and mobile with an OTP — about two minutes.
Enter the activation code from your institute, or pay online for instant access when enrolment is open.
Attempt timed mocks, watch structured lessons, and track accuracy, percentile and rank after every test.
